title: 第303章 吞金兽的日常第302章一个图案
slug: 百世轮回词条无限累加
lines: 清晨。皇家原野的铁匠坊里，炉火还没彻底熄灭。
苏璃把两枚打磨好的银牌放在桌上。边缘已经按照伊莲娜的要求，多磨圆了半毫米。
银牌背面的银杏叶纹路在晨光下泛着光泽。
“开饭了！”
赛娜的大嗓门从院子里传过来，伴随着锅铲敲击铁锅的清脆动静。
苏璃把银牌揣进兜里，推门走出去。
院子里已经乱成一锅粥。
小石头正拽着胖猫银的尾巴，在地上拖行。
银四脚朝天，生无可恋地翻着白皮肚，连挣扎都懒得挣扎，任由这小魔王把它当拖把用。
“石头！撒手！”赛娜端着一大盆排骨炖豆角从厨房出来，一脚踢开路上的木柴，“你再薅它毛，中午就没肉吃！”
小石头充耳不闻，咯咯笑着，手脚并用地往前爬。
苏璃走过去，弯腰把小石头拎起来，顺手把一枚银牌挂在他脖子上。
“这什么？”赛娜把盆搁在石桌上，凑过来看。
“护身符。”苏璃把小石头按在专用的高脚木椅上，“昨天下午打的，里面没封以太，纯当个念想。”
小石头低头看着胸前的银牌，伸出胖乎乎的手抓起来，直接往嘴里塞。
“哎！不能吃！”赛娜赶紧去抠他的嘴，“你这倒霉孩子，什么都往嘴里炫，绝壁是来讨债的！”
石桌另一边，伊莲娜正翻看账本。她今天穿了件干练的白衬衫，长发盘在脑后。
她的女儿坐在旁边的软垫椅子上，手里拿着一个复杂的木制鲁班锁，正一声不吭地拆解。
苏璃走过去，把另一枚空白银牌递给伊莲娜。
伊莲娜接过银牌，看了一眼背面的银杏叶，转头挂在了女儿脖子上。
小女孩停下手里的木块，低头盯着银牌看。
她没有往嘴里塞，而是用小手摸了摸边缘，又翻过来看了看背面，然后继续低头拆鲁班锁。
“名字想好没？”苏璃拉开椅子坐下，盛了一大碗米饭。
“没想好。”伊莲娜头也不抬，手里的笔在账本上划了一道，“鸢尾花家族的谱系太长，那些老家伙送来的备选名字全是一股子腐朽味。我打算自己翻古籍找。”
“随便起个顺口的就行了。”苏璃夹了一大块排骨，“你看石头这名字多好养活。”
伊莲娜冷哼一声。
“那是你的儿子，你叫他泥巴都行。我女儿以后是要继承整个王国财政的，叫什么？叫金币吗？”
“金币挺好啊，实在。”苏璃扒了一口饭，“多招财。”
赛娜在旁边笑出声。
“行了你们俩，大清早就抬杠。”赛娜给小石头的碗里舀了一勺肉汤拌饭，“赶紧吃，吃完去看看那几块温控田。昨天夜里降温，我怕新种的白菜冻坏了。”
艾洛诺儿端着一盘烤面包从厨房走出来。她今天换了身轻便的亚麻裙，银色长发用布条随意扎着。
“赛娜姐，温控田的回路我早上查过了，全都正常。”艾洛诺儿在小石头旁边坐下，顺手捏了捏他肉嘟嘟的脸蛋，“石头今天真乖。”
小石头挥舞着沾满米粒的勺子，含混不清地喊：“小姑……吃！”
艾洛诺儿脸一红，赶紧低头啃面包。
吃过早饭，苏璃溜达着往港口走。
银杏号安静地停在干坞里。
这艘造价昂贵的五阶远洋船，现在基本成了全家人的大型海景房。
塔莉娅已经在甲板上了。她正拿着一个以太探测仪，对着前甲板的菜箱测数据。
content_en:
early morning. In the blacksmith's workshop in the Royal Fields, the fire has not been completely extinguished.
Su Li placed two polished silver medals on the table. The edges have been rounded by half a millimeter more as requested by Elena.
The ginkgo leaf pattern on the back of the silver medal glows in the morning light.
"It's time to eat!"
Senna's loud voice came from the yard, accompanied by the clear sound of the spatula hitting the iron pot.
Su Li put the silver medal in her pocket, opened the door and walked out.
The yard has become a mess.
The little stone was dragging Fat Cat Yin by its tail on the ground.
Yin was lying on his back, with his white belly turning helplessly, not even bothering to struggle, letting the little devil use it as a mop.
"Stone! Let go!" Saina came out of the kitchen with a large pot of ribs and beans stewed and kicked the firewood away on the road. "If you keep picking at it, there will be no meat for lunch!"
The little stone turned a deaf ear, giggled, and crawled forward on hands and feet.
Su Li walked over, bent down to pick up the small stone, and hung a silver medal around his neck.
"What is this?" Senna put the basin on the stone table and came over to take a look.
"Amulet." Su Li pressed the small stone on the special high wooden chair. "I made it yesterday afternoon. There is no ether in it. It's just a thought."
Xiao Shitou looked down at the silver medal on his chest, stretched out his chubby hands to grab it, and stuffed it directly into his mouth.
"Hey! You can't eat it!" Senna quickly went to pick his mouth, "You unlucky kid, you show off everything in your mouth, Jubi is here to collect debts!"
On the other side of the stone table, Elena was looking through the ledger. She wore a crisp white shirt today, and her long hair was tied back.
Her daughter sat on a cushioned chair nearby, holding a complex wooden Luban lock in her hand, which she was dismantling without a word.
Su Li walked over and handed another blank silver medal to Elena.
Elena took the silver medal, glanced at the ginkgo leaves on the back, then turned around and hung it around her daughter's neck.
The little girl stopped holding the block of wood and stared down at the silver medal.
She didn't stuff it into her mouth, but touched the edge with her little hands, turned it over and looked at the back, and then continued to lower her head to remove the Luban lock.
"Have you thought of a name?" Su Li pulled out a chair and sat down, filling a large bowl of rice.
"I haven't thought about it." Elena didn't even raise her head, and drew a line on the ledger with the pen in her hand, "The Iris family has a long pedigree, and the alternative names sent by those old guys all smell of decay. I plan to look through ancient books myself."
"Just name it casually." Su Li sandwiched a large piece of ribs, "Look at how easy it is to make a living with the name Shitou."
Elena snorted coldly.
"That's your son, you can call him Nipa. My daughter will inherit the entire kingdom's finances in the future. What's her name? Is she called gold coin?"
"Gold coins are quite good, actually." Su Li took a bite of rice and said, "It will bring more wealth."
Sena laughed beside her.
"Okay, you two, start arguing early in the morning." Senna scooped a spoonful of broth mixed with rice into Xiao Shitou's bowl, "Eat quickly, and after eating, go check out the temperature-controlled fields. The temperature dropped last night, and I'm afraid the newly planted cabbage will freeze."
Elonelle came out of the kitchen carrying a plate of toast. Today she changed into a light linen skirt, and her long silver hair was tied up casually with a piece of cloth.
"Sister Saina, I checked the circuits of the temperature control field this morning and they are all normal." Elonelle sat down next to Little Shitou and pinched his chubby cheeks. "Shitou is so good today."
Little Shitou waved the spoon covered with rice grains and shouted vaguely: "Sister-in-law...eat!"
Elonelle blushed and quickly lowered her head to gnaw on the bread.
After breakfast, Su Li strolled towards the port.
The Ginkgo lay quietly in dry dock.
This expensive fifth-tier ocean-going ship has basically become a large ocean-view room for the whole family.
Thalia was already on deck. She was holding an ether detector and measuring data on the vegetable box on the front deck.
